C9000142.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 142 (Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields.; papers: Deterministic Polynomial Factorization over Prime Fields; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_NORM_SOLVE.statement: Under the exact hypotheses of norm:solve, the explicit local-order, section-space, fiber and extraction construction returns h with Norm(h)=G in uniform deterministic polynomial time without an irreducible-factorization oracle.

L_NORM_ROOT.statement: The finite reduced-algebra root routine supplies all promised residue roots using only polynomially bounded gcds, Frobenius linear algebra, primary digit logarithms and CRT.

L_NORM_LOCAL.statement: The displayed cyclic matrix models and scaled-basis orders are maximal; every section coordinate has local valuation at least -(N+D+2), independently of residue-root choices.

L_NORM_PRECISION.statement: The bounded rational ansatz and local congruences compute all global sections and the exact infinity evaluation; precision 2L+1 suffices with L=N+D+2.

L_NORM_FORMAL_CORE.statement: For formal power series, multiplication and finite sums preserve equality of coefficients through any prescribed degree; vanishing below 2m and the coefficient at 2m depend only on precision 2m+1.

L_NORM_FIBER.statement: The exact section algebra is an endomorphism algebra of a vector bundle on P1; its infinity image is block upper triangular, and the trace-kernel algorithm constructs a rank-one fiber idempotent.

L_NORM_RECOVERY.statement: A lift b of the fiber idempotent has characteristic polynomial T^(q-1)(T-1); b^q is rank-one idempotent, and solving Ve=he recovers Norm(h)=G.

L_NORM_BOUNDS.statement: All root, local-congruence, section, power and final-solve steps have uniform polynomial degree and bit bounds and field-dependent zero-test branches only.

C_DIV_ARITHMETIC.statement: Manuscript div:arithmetic, div:compression, div:trace and div:circuits provide the stated factorization-free divisor and function operations; not certified in this mission.

C_DIV_DIVIDE.statement: Manuscript div:divide reduces promised (1-sigma)-class division to norm:solve and divisor arithmetic.

C_GEOMETRIC_LIFTS.statement: Manuscript geom:descent, geom:lifts and geom:separation provide rational lifts and forced separation; not certified in this mission.

C_ODD_SPLIT.statement: Manuscript odd:split uses promised class division, simultaneous divisor arithmetic, rational lifts and forced separation to split odd-degree totally split input.

C_DRIVER_COMPLEXITY.statement: Manuscript driver:correctness and complexity:bound give the factoring recursion and uniform polynomial bound conditional on auxiliary primes.

C_MAIN_REDUCTION.statement: Manuscript thm:reduction deterministically factors given auxiliary primes satisfying its explicit congruence and nonresidue conditions.

C_ANALYTIC_AUXILIARY.statement: Manuscript analytic:auxiliary derives polynomial auxiliary-prime bounds from the companion uniform Hecke zero-free assertion; analytic validity remains unverified.

C_MAIN_FACTORIZATION.statement: Manuscript thm:factorization combines thm:reduction with analytic:auxiliary for unconditional deterministic polynomial-time factorization over prime fields.

C_NORM_BUDGET.statement: Under norm:solve's hypotheses, L=N+D+2 suffices in place of M=10q^2(N+D+1): q^2(L(deg H+1)+1) scalar unknowns and precision 2L+1 compute all sections and the infinity fiber.

C_NORM_DIAGNOSTIC.statement: For q=3, k=F_19, zeta=7, omega=4, F=X^3-2 and G=2, the actual full 225-by-189 system has rank 180; the section and fiber dimensions are 9, and the constructed h=X-Y has norm 2. This is a finite exact diagnostic, not a universal proof.
